findings.decision: Align semantic registry/package design with glTF 2.1 external assets, stable IDs and node bounds; do not adopt as production baseline until normative status is clear.
findings.contradiction: Khronos technical article says schema/spec work is still being finalized while event messaging says glTF 2.1 is here.

findings.decision: Benchmark meshoptimizer v1.3 clusterlod before investing further in bespoke HLOD/meshlet hierarchy; keep EXT_meshopt_compression as compatibility baseline.
findings.contradiction: Several new APIs remain experimental and KHR_meshopt_compression support is not yet as broad as EXT_meshopt_compression.

findings.decision: Add an isolated r187-dev benchmark lane for instancing/shadows, but keep batching and WebGL fallback as architectural requirements.
findings.contradiction: The relevant upstream changes are still open/unreleased; WebGPU does not remove object-count costs.

findings.decision: Use mesh/proxy + selective Gaussian appearance + semantic anchors as the default research hypothesis for interactive captured environments.
findings.contradiction: Pure splats can remain preferable for view synthesis; explicit meshes remain stronger for collision, editing and deterministic interaction.

findings.decision: Prioritize Catalan Catedra Gaudi/ETSAB primary evidence and label reconstructed features documented, inferred or creative; use Codi Gaudi as a benchmark, not unquestioned ground truth.
findings.contradiction: Scientific curation does not make every exhibition reconstruction a primary geometric source.

findings.decision: Use Blender 5.2 LTS as research baseline for new procedural generators; exploit Geometry Bundles for semantic/provenance data but build an API compatibility shim before migration.
findings.contradiction: 5.2 LTS improves procedural composition but changes Geometry Nodes modifier Python property access.

findings.decision: Make an open Generic Cyclist Model benchmark the gate before any personalized virtual-wind-tunnel accuracy claim; validate flow field as well as drag.
findings.contradiction: Generic models improve reproducibility but do not prove transfer of an optimum to an individual athlete.

findings.decision: Replace triangle-count-only LOD acceptance with screen-space/perceptual and silhouette/material-weighted tests plus small human A/B gates.
findings.contradiction: There is no universal safe decimation percentage; thresholds are content, task and display dependent.

findings.decision: Require semantic parts, material slots, scale and provenance for AI-generated products/worlds; use AI for proxies/material proposals, not as engineering authority.
findings.contradiction: Generative benchmark gains do not guarantee CAD accuracy, manufacturability, stable topology or brand fidelity.
